% PGF heart plot marks used as workflow approval checkpoints.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,plotmarks,positioning}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  node distance=2.8cm,
  stage/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=2.1cm,minimum height=8mm},
  flow/.style={-Stealth,thick}
]
  \node[stage] (draft) {Draft};
  \node[stage,right=of draft] (review) {Review};
  \node[stage,right=of review] (approve) {Approve};
  \node[stage,right=of approve] (release) {Release};
  \draw[flow] (draft) -- (review);
  \draw[flow] (review) -- (approve);
  \draw[flow] (approve) -- (release);
  \draw[red!80!black,fill=red!30,mark size=7pt]
    plot[mark=heart] coordinates {(1.4,0)};
  \draw[blue!70!black,fill=blue!25,mark size=7pt]
    plot[mark=heart,mark options={rotate=12}] coordinates {(4.2,0)};
  \draw[green!45!black,fill=green!25,mark size=7pt]
    plot[mark=heart] coordinates {(7,0)};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
